android.desc:
Ayafy is a Quran learning and memorization app designed to help you memorize the Quran, practise recitation, revise what you have learned, understand Quranic verses, and build a consistent daily routine. 

With AI-powered recitation tracking, structured revision, memorization progress, Quran audio playback, translations, Tafsir, and a beautiful Quran reader, Ayafy brings your Quran learning journey together in one place. 

AI-powered recitation review
Practise reciting the Quran from memory while Ayafy tracks your recitation word by word in real time.
* Identify correct, incorrect, and skipped words
* Review mistakes and areas for improvement
* View session summaries, duration, and recitation ratings
 
Smart revision and practice
Strengthen your Hifz with structured revision sessions.
* Test your recall with missing-ayah questions
* Practise reciting the next ayah from memory
* Pause and resume revision sessions anytime
* Set separate goals for revision and testing 

Quran memorization tracker
Track your progress across the entire Quran.
* View progress by Surah, Juz, or page
* Mark sections as memorized or partially memorized
* Explore detailed memorization and revision history
* Track when you first learned or last revised a section 

Goals and streaks
Build a consistent Quran learning routine.
* Set daily memorization goals
* Create goals for specific Surahs and Juz
* Track progress and daily streaks
* Monitor your progress over time 

Quran reader
Enjoy a focused reading experience with flexible layouts and settings.
* Read using the 15-line Madani Mushaf layout
* Choose available Quran layouts and fonts
* Adjust font size in the line-by-line reader
* Navigate by Surah, page, Juz, and Hizb
* Access translations, Tafsir, and English transliteration
* Choose light or dark mode 

Quran audio playback
Listen to Quran recitations and practise ayah by ayah.
* Play individual ayahs
* Choose from available reciters, with more coming in future updates
* Adjust playback speed: 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, or 2x
* Repeat each ayah 2, 3, 4, or 5 times
* Turn repetition off or loop an ayah continuously

Quran translations and Tafsir 
Understand Quranic verses with additional reading support.
* Explore translations in available languages
* Read Tafsir for explanation and context
* View translation, Tafsir, and transliteration directly from individual ayahs 

AI voice search
Find Quran verses more easily.
* Search by

quotes.text:
I built Ayafy, a free Quran learning app on iOS and Android. It lets you manage memorisation, automatically prepares revision tests as you study, measure progress, establish goals and review your recitation with AI-powered word-by-word feedback. It has also a quran reader, voice search and much more.

I would love to hear your open feedback & ideas for improvements!

Website: https://ayafy.com
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ayafy/id1549129832
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ayafy.app
